name: jb-components

appliesTo.notes: Next.js 15 App Router + React 19 + Tailwind CSS 3.4 only (Tailwind v4 not supported) + TypeScript; Thai/English UI, dark mode via data-theme (never Tailwind dark:), brand colors via CSS variables. Source: AGENTS.md, docs/guide/02-setup.md, package.json.

scaffoldHints: Pin the scaffold to Next 15: npx create-next-app@15 apps/web --ts --tailwind --eslint --app --src-dir --import-alias "@/*" --use-npm --no-git --yes (the kit imports itself with @/ -> ./src/*; the STACK.md command without --src-dir gives "@/*": ["./*"]).

create-next-app installs Tailwind v4 (@tailwindcss/postcss, no tailwind.config); after scaffolding run in apps/web: npm uninstall @tailwindcss/postcss && npm install -D tailwindcss@^3.4.19 postcss autoprefixer. The installer overwrites postcss.config.mjs, tailwind.config.ts and src/app/globals.css.
Delete the scaffold src/app/layout.tsx before running install-kit.mjs: "generated" files are written only when missing, so the kit root layout (providers) would otherwise be kept out.
Run install-kit.mjs with --install (or npm install the listed packages) in apps/web, then npm run build to confirm.
components: ui (Card, Button, Chip, Field, Input, Textarea, Progress, Empty, Skeleton, SkeletonText)
admin/kit (DataTable, Toolbar, FilterSelect, Pagination, SectionCard, StatCard, AdminPageHeader, InfoNote)
charts (ChartCard, TrendChart, BarsChart, DonutChart, Heatmap, CalendarHeatmap, KpiCard, RankList, Sparkline)
blocks (Reveal, SiteNav, Hero, LogoCloud, FeatureBento, Steps, StatsBand, Testimonials, FaqSection, CtaBand, SiteFooter)
rules: Use the kit component whenever one fits the requirement; do not write your own (AGENTS.md, docs/guide/03-requirement-map.md "ห้ามทำเอง").

No hard-coded colors (bg-white, text-red-500, bg-[#hex]) and no Tailwind dark:; use tokens (bg-paper, bg-surface, text-ink, bg-brand-600, text-brand-link, ok/warn/danger) (docs/guide/05-rules.md "สี และโหมดมืด").
Tailwind opacity steps that do not exist (/12, /7, /3, /6) silently produce no class; use /10 or an arbitrary value like /[0.06] (docs/guide/05-rules.md "Tailwind opacity").

Field is a <label> by default: wrap fields with buttons or several elements (Combobox, Select, DatePicker, DateRangePicker, NumberInput, TagInput, RadioGroup, PasswordInput, Slider, FileDrop, ImagePicker) with as="div"; never wrap Checkbox/Switch/Radio in a label Field (docs/guide/05-rules.md "Field").

Files using state/handlers need 'use client'; no function props from a server component; useSearchParams needs <Suspense> in the page; toast/confirmDialog are client-only (docs/guide/05-rules.md "Server / Client component").

No Math.random(), Date.now() or new Date() during render, and localStorage/window only in useEffect; pass an explicit locale (th-TH) or use formatNumber/formatDate (docs/guide/05-rules.md "Hydration").
Never remove i18n keys in src/lib/i18n/dict.th.ts / dict.en.ts; add new keys to both files (docs/guide/05-rules.md "ข้อความ ภาษา i18n").

Stored and API dates are ISO Gregorian (YYYY-MM-DD); DatePicker value is a string, empty = ''; NumberInput empty = null; Combobox empty = null; DataTable rows need a numeric id (docs/guide/05-rules.md "ฟอร์มและข้อมูล").

List filters, search and page live in the URL (useSearchParams + router.replace), reset page on filter change; confirmDialog before delete; keep pure logic in .ts files for vitest (docs/guide/05-rules.md "ฟอร์มและข้อมูล").
Shortcuts are written 'mod+K' (never ctrlKey||metaKey or a hard-coded "Ctrl+K"); icon-only buttons need aria-label; no 375px horizontal scroll; min-h-dvh not min-h-screen (docs/guide/05-rules.md).
